# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No fixes required. The review approved the round-2 implementation (from_value extraction, SchemaVersionMismatch removal, u32::try_from fix) with zero findings or gaps. All code remains unchanged from the plan_and_implement stage.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Verified review outcome: approved with empty findings_or_gaps and empty follow_up_or_amendments — no code changes needed.
2. [Completed] Ran full quality check suite (cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check) to confirm the implementation remains clean.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test: all 148 tests pass across all crates (including 10 save_load tests with 4 migration-specific tests)
- cargo clippy -- -D warnings: zero warnings across all crates
- cargo fmt --check: no formatting diff
- Review outcome was 'approved' with empty findings_or_gaps and empty follow_up_or_amendments arrays

## Outstanding Risks

- The v2→v3 migration is frozen as raw-JSON logic independent of WaterState::rescale_totals_for_volume; this is by design for migration immutability (carried forward, unchanged)
